extra.description: 20-turn agentic trajectory: K-amnesia vs V-schema drift
extra.mode: simulated (no LLM/GPU on host); behaviour driven by measured quantizer error
extra.isolation: first-order: a mis-retrieval is recorded but not propagated to later turns
extra.trajectory: 20-turn ReAct script over 24 files with 6 backtracking revisits

metric_definitions.k_amnesia_reread_rate: fraction of turns where quantized retrieval selects a file other than the scripted target and the selected file was last read >20000 tokens earlier (a re-read of a forgotten span)
metric_definitions.v_schema_corruption_rate: fraction of turns where any emitted payload slot decodes to the wrong symbol (6 slots sampled on the 5 apply_diff turns)
metric_definitions.loop_collapse_turn: first turn at which a file has been visited 3 times and at least one of those visits produced an unparseable payload; -1 if the run never collapsed
metric_definitions.task_resolved_rate: fraction of runs with no corrupted payload on any apply_diff turn and no loop collapse

extra.subsample: 256 sampled token keys/turn (1:256 of 64K); tail understated, so rates are conservative
